info.title: Convex API
info.description: Convex HTTP contract. Mutations require Origin matching CONVEX_PUBLIC_URL and X-Convex-CSRF: 1, including public authentication endpoints. Cookies are HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure on HTTPS, and use CONVEX_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS (default seven days), with no sliding renewal. Shortening the lifetime caps existing sessions; increasing it does not extend them. Tokens in invitation/reset links use URL fragments and are submitted in JSON bodies. Errors use ApiError. Protected operations recheck active accounts, workspace membership, and authentication policy without contacting an identity provider. Logout revokes only the Convex session.

get.summary: Returns the same contract exported by the offline generation command.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Provider-returned opaque state; requires matching browser-binding cookie

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Authorization code; exactly one of code or error

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Provider cancellation or denial; details are discarded

303.description: Single-use browser-bound callback. Redirects to fixed login outcome or account method destination; session cookie for successful login/linking, HttpOnly proof cookie for reauthentication. Cache-Control: no-store; Referrer-Policy: no-referrer. Provider errors are sanitized.

200.description: Authorization URL and HttpOnly browser-binding cookie; requires same-origin CSRF headers
